name: ^call\.abortSignal\.addEventListener$
reason: Fixed arguments; the listener only aborts the batch, and the twin reads nothing back.

name: ^clearTimeout$
reason: Cancels the batch timer the twin passes; it answers nothing.

name: ^send$
reason: The batch sender is an injected boundary; flushBatch never reads its answer before returning.

name: ^AbortSignal\.(any|timeout)$
reason: The platform builds a signal from checked inputs; the twin only passes it on.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: The clock is an input.

name: ^fetch$
reason: The network's answer is the outside world; request URL and options are checked.

name: ^requireEnv$
reason: Reads the checked variable name; its value is configuration.

name: ^isTimeoutError$
reason: Classifies the checked error; the branch taken is observable in later effects.

name: ^isUnreachableError$
reason: Classifies the checked error; the branch taken is observable in later effects.

name: ^toErrorMessage$
reason: Renders the checked error into the message the twin then checks.

name: ^new WorkerNotRunError$
reason: Constructs the error from the checked message and status.

name: ^onInvoked$
reason: The caller's meter callback, given the checked start time.

name: ^response\.(text|arrayBuffer)$
reason: The body of a checked response is the outside answer.

name: ^responseStream\.(write|end)$
reason: Lambda's response stream receives the checked frame.

name: ^process\.kill$
reason: The OS call, with the checked process group and signal.

name: ^child\.kill$
reason: The OS call, with the checked signal.

name: ^worker\.getEntrypoint(<LoadedEntrypoint>\("Loaded"\)\.ping)?$
reason: The Worker Loader stub; the twin passes its promise to the checked deadline.

name: ^bundles( \.get|\.put)$
reason: R2 is the outside store, addressed by the checked content key.

name: ^object\.arrayBuffer$
reason: The stored object's bytes are re-hashed by the checked digest.

name: ^crypto\.subtle\.digest$
reason: The platform hash of checked bytes; the result is compared to the expected value.

name: ^ctx\.waitUntil$
reason: Workers runtime keep-alive for the checked write-back.

name: ^stream\.getReader$
reason: Streams platform call; each read's answer is checked input.

name: ^reader\.(read|releaseLock)$
reason: Stream reads are the outside answer; release is checked in order.

name: ^writable\.getWriter$
reason: Streams platform call; each write is checked.

name: ^writer\.(write|close|abort)$
reason: Writes to the response stream are checked byte for byte.

name: FakeChild
reason: Test stand-in for ChildProcess; the twins read only its pid or pass it on.

name: FakeWritable
reason: Test stand-in for a child stream; the twins only pass it on.

name: FakeStream
reason: Test stand-in for a child stream; the twins only pass it on.

name: WritableStream
reason: Only handed to getWriter.

name: WritableStreamDefaultWriter
reason: Only called through checked writer effects.

name: ReadableStreamDefaultReader
reason: Only called through checked reader effects.

name: ReadableStream
reason: Only handed to the checked reader effects.

name: TenantOutbound
reason: The receiver; the twin reads only the egress blocklist from its props.
